mapper.select:
/* 업무일지 조회 (5030) - 차트1 데이터 */ /* TaskLogInquiryMapper.selectList */ WITH VW_TASK AS ( SELECT INPT_ATMC_BIZ_DSCD, INPT_MST_SRNO, INPT_RCP_DT
, SUBSTR(INPT_RCP_DT,1,6) AS INPT_RCP_YM FROM CSPD001TM WHERE INPT_RCP_DT BETWEEN REPLACE(#{schSdate1},'-','') AND REPLACE(#{schEdate1},'-','') AND AI_INPT_APPV_STCD IN ('160', '140' ,'130') ) SELECT A.INPT_RCP_DT AS DAY, A.EXP_CNT AS EXPORT, A.IMP_CNT AS IMPORT FROM ( SELECT A.INPT_RCP_DT , NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN A.INPT_ATMC_BIZ_DSCD = '1' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END),0) AS IMP_CNT , NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN A.INPT_ATMC_BIZ_DSCD = '2' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END),0) AS EXP_CNT FROM VW_TASK A GROUP BY A.INPT_RCP_DT ORDER BY TO_NUMBER(A.INPT_RCP_DT) ASC ) A

/* 업무일지 조회 (5030) - 차트2 데이터 */ /* TaskLogInquiryMapper.selectList */ WITH VW_TASK AS ( /* 심사작업목록 - 검색일자 */ SELECT INPT_MST_SRNO, AI_INPT_QLAS_PROS_CD, AI_INPT_PROS_CD, AI_INPT_ACVT_CD, INPT_ATMC_BIZ_DSCD , TOTALTEXT_AI_INPT_RST_CD, ITM_INPT_AI_INPT_RST_CD, SAFEWATCH_AI_INPT_RST_CD, INPT_RCP_DT , CASE WHEN AI_INPT_ACVT_CD IN ('160','140') AND (TOTALTEXT_AI_INPT_RST_CD IN ('30','40') OR ITM_INPT_AI_INPT_RST_CD IN('30','40') OR SAFEWATCH_AI_INPT_RST_CD IN ('30','40')) THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END AS ALERT_YN /* 경보건 여부 YN */ , (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT INPT_MST_SRNO) FROM CSPD008TH WHERE INPT_MST_SRNO = A.INPT_MST_SRNO AND AI_INPT_ACVT_STS_CD = '60') AS RESCAN_CNT /* 재스캔 건수 */ , (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT INPT_MST_SRNO) FROM CSPD008TH WHERE INPT_MST_SRNO = A.INPT_MST_SRNO AND AI_INPT_ACVT_STS_CD = '70') AS REPROC_CNT /* 재추출 건수 */ , (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT INPT_MST_SRNO) FROM CSPD008TH WHERE INPT_MST_SRNO = A.INPT_MST_SRNO AND AI_INPT_ACVT_STS_CD = '80') AS SUGI_CNT /* 수기 건수 */ FROM CSPD001TM A WHERE INPT_RCP_DT BETWEEN REPLACE(#{schSdate1},'-','') AND REPLACE(#{schEdate1},'-','') )
SELECT DISTINCT A.INPT_RCP_DT AS DAY, NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN A.ALERT_YN = 'Y' AND A.SAFEWATCH_AI_INPT_RST_CD IN('30', '40') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END),0)||'' AS SW, NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN A.ALERT_YN = 'Y' AND A.ITM_INPT_AI_INPT_RST_CD IN('30', '40') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END),0)||'' AS HANG, NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN A.ALERT_YN = 'Y' AND A.TOTALTEXT_AI_INPT_RST_CD IN('30', '40') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END),0)||'' AS TOT FROM VW_TASK A GROUP BY A.INPT_RCP_DT ORDER BY A.INPT_RCP_DT
